description.shortDescription: A strategic board game where you out-think your opponent to control the board.
description.howToPlay: Take turns placing pieces on the board. The first player to form a continuous line of 5 pieces in any direction wins. Horizontal, vertical, and diagonal lines all count. If the board fills up without a winner, the game is a draw.
description.tips: Control the center of the board early. Watch for your opponent forming 3-in-a-row setups and block them. Try to create two threats at once to force a win.
